title: Magnetic item
description: A magnet that attracts everything around it
body:
**🧲 Magnetic Mod
Tired of running around picking up every single item drop? Let the magnet do the work.

**✨ Features**

Automatic item attraction — Hold the magnet in your main hand or offhand and every item within 12 blocks gets pulled straight to you
Smooth acceleration — Items don't just teleport, they fly toward you with a satisfying magnetic pull that speeds up the closer they get
Auto pickup — Items land directly into your inventory without you lifting a finger
Visual effects — Rotating rings of electric sparks and enchantment particles swirl around you while the magnet is active
Sound design — A subtle magnetic hum lets you know the magnet is working


**🎮 How to use**

Craft or obtain the Magnet item
Hold it in your main hand or offhand
Watch every nearby item fly into your inventory automatically


**🔧 Compatibility**

Minecraft 1.20.1
Requires Forge


**📦 Perfect for
Modpacks with heavy mob farming, ore mining sessions, or anyone who just hates clicking items off the ground.**
